question: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Vector Network Analyzer in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?
answer: The Vault's wireless-communication evidence for VNAs is strongest in four areas, all of it presentation-/application-level rather than formal solution bundles. (1) Higher frequencies and mmWave/early-6G RF for mobile network infrastructure: the MWC2025 network-infrastructure deck lists R&S ZNA up to 67 GHz, ZNA67EXT up to 110 GHz, ZNB and ZVA (10 MHz-110 GHz) plus banded mmW converters up to 1.1 THz under its "More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies" driver, and also places the ZNA in the small-cell / RF design and compliance slide. (2) Beamforming, Massive MIMO and active-antenna verification: the same source pairs beamforming component/accuracy verification with the R&S ZNBT multiport network analyzer (<=40 GHz) and simultaneous measurement on up to 24 ports in one instrument, while the ZNA specification independently supports true parallel and coherent acquisition for antenna array tests and antenna test systems, with optional direct IF access for antenna measurement systems and mmWave converters. (3) Satellite/NTN communication: the ZNA is positioned for component-level payload work including group delay of frequency converters without LO access (two-tone technique, calibration with only an unknown-through mixer), appears in R&S NTN PAAM/beam test setups, and is mapped across the Taiwan satellite chain to antenna G/T, ground stations, UT and communication modules (ZNA / ZNB3000). (4) Terminal and antenna OTA/passive test: the Starlink UT flow lists the ZNA for VNA/array calibration (against Keysight PNA-X), the Kuiper UT flow lists a VNA as core OTA-chamber equipment, and the Taiwan UAV chain maps ZNB3000 to antenna high-isolation and OTA passive testing. A weaker, model-less lead is 5G NR SAR system calibration, where the source only says "VNA and VSG help the calibration of SAR test system". Nearly every mapping page explicitly warns that no option, fixture, frequency or calibration configuration is given, so these are lead-level opportunities, not quotable configurations.
missing: The Vault has no dedicated "Vector Network Analyzer" concept page and no market-sizing, win/loss, pipeline, pricing or competitive-share data for VNAs in wireless communication, so opportunities cannot be ranked quantitatively. All application mappings are slide-level: the pages themselves state that no option codes, fixtures, frequency ranges, calibration methods or test setups are given (e.g. the MWC2025 and AISeverEcosystem mapping pages, and the UAV/satellite chain pages). There is also no evidence tying VNAs to handset/RF-front-end-module or filter/duplexer production test in wireless devices beyond the ZNA-B15 MIPI RFFE GPIO option listed in the datasheet without any application context, and no ZNBT product/spec page exists to confirm its stated capabilities.

key_points.point: The strongest infrastructure opportunity is mmWave / higher-frequency and early-6G network analysis, where the MWC2025 network-infrastructure deck lists ZNA up to 67 GHz and ZNA67EXT up to 110 GHz.
key_points.quote: Network analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S ZNA]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] up to 110 GHz

key_points.point: Beamforming / Massive MIMO component and accuracy verification is a named VNA opportunity, addressed by the R&S ZNBT multiport network analyzer up to 40 GHz with simultaneous measurement on up to 24 ports in one instrument.
key_points.quote: 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）

key_points.point: The ZNA's multi-source, multi-receiver architecture supports antenna array tests and antenna test systems with true parallel and coherent data acquisition, which underpins the active-antenna/array opportunity.
key_points.quote: 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。

key_points.point: For satellite communication payloads and components, the ZNA is positioned for group delay of frequency converters without LO access using a two-tone technique, i.e. component-level testing.
key_points.quote: [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay

key_points.point: In the Taiwan satellite supply-chain mapping, VNAs (ZNA / ZNB3000) are mapped to antenna G/T measurement, and the ZNA also to ground stations, UT and communication-module players.
key_points.source: wiki/concepts/台灣衛星產業鏈 R&S solution mapping.md
key_points.quote: | 天線 | [[芳興科技]] | G/T | [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB3000]] |

key_points.point: Satellite user-terminal test flows list a VNA for phased-array calibration, with the ZNA named alongside the incumbent Keysight PNA-X.
key_points.source: wiki/concepts/Starlink User Terminal 測試流程.md
key_points.quote: | VNA / array calibration | Keysight PNA-X、[[R&S ZNA]] |

key_points.point: Antenna high-isolation measurement and OTA passive testing in the Taiwan UAV wireless chain is mapped to the R&S ZNB3000.
key_points.source: wiki/concepts/台灣 UAV 產業鏈 R&S solution mapping.md
key_points.quote: high isolation measurement；OTA passive testing | [[R&S ZNB3000]]；[[R&S TS8991]]（[[R&S AMS32]]）

key_points.point: A weaker, model-less opportunity is calibration of 5G NR SAR test systems, where the source only states that a VNA and VSG assist calibration without naming instruments or procedure.
key_points.quote: 同頁寫 VNA and VSG help the calibration of SAR test system，但未列具體型號或 calibration procedure
